blocks.html: With nearly a decade under my belt as a tech journalist jet-setting with the likes of Meta, Huawei and Google, I now leverage this global insider perspective to help startups and executives unlock the potential of AI. Blending hands-on creativity with automation, I lead personalized workshops and group trainings to solve complex business challenges. While I like efficient laziness, and I champion efficiency, I'm not afraid to get gritty and think outside the box. I find balance escaping the digital world on my road bike, though my love of chocolate remains - no matter what my diabetes has to say.
